36175103517d.text: Every web call waits for your Allow. This switch would skip that; leave it off.

ef9c13a4ef26.text: The simplest way to share is the workflow itself. Every row on a Context node is a copy of its item, so a saved workflow runs on another machine even with an empty library. Rows they don't have show as missing, and right-click, Save to library adds them.

f0f12a8d4482.text: Accepts groups also let constraints match tag for tag, and tags filter references inside wildcards. Both come next.

f1b17e1046c9.text: Done shows it as a panel. It never runs, and it's saved with the workflow.

f1f63bf7fa68.text: Run, and see what it rolls.

f2567cdd4908.text: A Context Loop runs the workflow several times from one click. Each frame rolls its own picks.

f299418696d2.text: And the refined picks land here, each under its look.

f2d342f41fc5.text: Now make Colors pick two for this node: right-click it, Edit, and set the pick to exactly two.

f303d1656139.text: Only the picks go on: upscaled by one and a half and sampled again at half denoise.

f50d114bc4b9.text: You can also write several picks right in a template or an option. Curly brackets, a count, two dollar signs, the joiner, two more dollar signs, then the choices.
